text: You see one forgets to particularize an old woman and her boy.” “Dr. and Mrs. Bretton were at M. de Bassompierre’s this evening?” “Ay, ay! as large as life; and missy played the hostess. What a conceited doll it is!” Soured and listless, Miss Fanshawe was beginning to disclose the causes of her prostrate condition. There had been a retrenchment of incense, a diversion or a total withholding of homage and attention coquetry had failed of effect, vanity had undergone mortification.
